add.title: Add the photos
add.formats: JPEG, PNG, HEIC or a PDF scan. Up to 10 photos and 50 MB per receipt.

line.tooMany_one: {{count}} photo was not added — a receipt takes at most 10.
line.tooMany_other: {{count}} photos were not added — a receipt takes at most 10.
line.tooBig: The photos add up to {{size}} MB, exceeding the 50 MB limit.

total.linesAdd_one: {{count}} line adds up to {{total}} — accept that or enter the printed total.
total.linesAdd_other: {{count}} lines add up to {{total}} — accept that or enter the printed total.

quota.unlimited: No receipt limit on this account.
quota.used: You have used all {{limit}} receipts this month. More can be read from {{resets}}.
quota.short_one: Only {{count}} receipt left this month, and this upload has {{needed}}. Remove {{extra}} to read the rest, or wait until {{resets}}.
quota.short_other: Only {{count}} receipts left this month, and this upload has {{needed}}. Remove {{extra}} to read the rest, or wait until {{resets}}.

already.stored: {{name}} is already stored — you added it on {{date}}. It will not be stored again.

read.title: What we read
read.conflicts_one: {{count}} thing needs a decision from you — you will get to it on the next step. Read through first and fix anything obviously wrong here.
read.conflicts_other: {{count}} things need a decision from you — you will get to them on the next step. Read through first and fix anything obviously wrong here.
read.failedText: The AI service was temporarily overloaded or unavailable.
read.undated: No date on the receipt, so it is dated the day you uploaded it: {{date}}.
read.notReceiptTitle: This doesn't look like a receipt
read.notReceiptText: Please review carefully. You can proceed to resolve it manually or go back to upload a different photo.
read.duplicateTitle: You may already have this one
read.duplicateText: {{merchant}}, {{date}}, {{total}} {{currency}} is already stored. Two trips on one day are perfectly normal — you decide.
read.missingBoth: No total or date could be read, so it is excluded from budget calculation until you fill it in.
read.missingTotal: No total could be read, so it is excluded from budget calculation until you fill it in.
read.missingDate: No date could be read, so it is excluded from budget calculation until you fill it in.
read.setLater: Set it from the receipt's Edit once it is stored.
read.mismatch: Lines do not match printed total

conversion.unavailable: No {{currency}} to {{account}} rate could be found for this date. It will be stored in {{currency}} and wait in review, not counted, until you enter the amounts in {{account}}.
conversion.paidIn: Paid in {{currency}}; it will be counted in {{account}}.

resolve.noTotal: No total anywhere on the photos
resolve.hardTotal: The printed total was hard to read
resolve.untilEmpty: Nothing is stored until this list is empty.
resolve.dupTitle: You may already have this receipt
resolve.notPossibleText: Overlap checking is skipped rather than guessed. Retake that frame and it runs again.
resolve.overlapQuestion: The receipt was shot in two overlapping frames. This line sits at the bottom of the first and the top of the second — one purchase caught twice, or two identical purchases?
resolve.name: Name

fix.title: Fix what we read
fix.subtitle: {{merchant}} · leave a price empty if the receipt does not show one.
fix.dateAssumed: Not on the receipt — this is the day you uploaded it.
fix.notStored: Nothing is stored until you finish the last step.

unconfirmed.title: Confirm your address to add receipts
unconfirmed.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. Follow it, then come back here — receipts you photograph or forward wait for that one step.
